---
title: "Visualisation exercise"
author: "Giulia Goggi"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)

locations <- read_csv("data/movebank_data.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp))

gt(head(locations))
```

```{r}
loc_selected <- locations |>
  select(date, individual_local_identifier, location_long, location_lat)

gt(head(loc_selected))
```

```{r}
loc_sel_group <- loc_selected |>
  group_by(date, individual_local_identifier)

loc_summarised <- loc_sel_group |>
  summarise(Longitude = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE),
            Latitude = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE))
gt(head(loc_summarised))
```

```{r}
min_long = loc_summarised |> pull(Longitude) |> min()
max_long = loc_summarised |> pull(Longitude) |> max()
min_lat = loc_summarised |> pull(Latitude) |> min()
max_lat = loc_summarised |> pull(Latitude) |> max()

ggplot(loc_summarised, aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = individual_local_identifier)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_long - 0.5, max_long + 0.5), ylim = c(min_lat - 0.2, max_lat + 0.2)) +
  ggtitle('Seals location identification') + 
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
